card.name: Leftovers and by-products being used
card.fires_on: Verbs and punctuation just before the text names a leftover, by-product or remainder, such as what is left after processing, harvesting or mixing.

modes.label: By-products of processing
modes.description: Sentences about waste or by-products from food, crops or sewage that get reused or sold.
modes.example: A new law in Michigan will make it easier for sewage treatment plants to<< sell>> or give away their leftovers.

modes.label: Handling a remaining mixture or fraction
modes.description: Instructions to drink or save what remains after dispersing a tablet or separating a sample.
modes.example: Rinse the container with an additional 120 mL (4 ounces) of water and<< drink>>.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning residue, remainder, extracted material and by-product, especially in Chinese.
